candidates.change_summary: Change `block.number + 1` to `block.number + 2` so the stored block number differs, altering when settle() becomes valid.
Remove the `require(msg.value == 1 ether)` statement so that calls with different or zero ether succeed and change state.
Change the require condition to `guesses[msg.sender].block != 0` to invert the guard, allowing overwrites or rejecting valid first calls.
Delete the line `guesses[msg.sender].guess = hash;` so the guess is never stored.
Store `block.number` instead of `block.number + 1`, changing the blockhash used in settlement.
Change winning payout from 2 ether to 0 ether so settle never pays out.
Change winning payout from 2 ether to 1 ether so correct guess returns only the stake.
Remove the conditional transfer completely so settle never pays even on correct guess.
Replace the blockhash source with block.number so the answer changes, altering who wins.
Replace blockhash source with a constant zero bytes32 so correct guess is always zero.
Change the require block number check to > instead of >= so users must wait one extra block.
Delete the require that checks block number is past the guess block, allowing early settle with zero blockhash.
